style: One standalone Kalistar collectible equipment illustration, never a complete card. Detailed narrative heroic fantasy painting, visible faceted brush strokes, worn cloth, leather and metal, hierarchical edges, tangible crafted materials. Neither photograph, smooth 3D nor anime. Entire object clearly readable and uncropped, centered front three-quarter view filling about 75 percent of height, portrait 4:5. Quiet setting with depth and only a few meaningful details. Motivated soft light, highest contrast on the object, no bokeh or atmospheric blobs, no overload of ornaments. No people, mannequin, hands, words, numbers, interface, borders or watermark. Preserve known collaboration object silhouettes without replacing them by generic magical armor.
